title: Digital arrest over a WhatsApp video call (Hinglish)

timeline.call: Hello, main Mumbai police cyber crime branch se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon.
Aapke naam se FedEx parcel mein drugs aur paanch fake passports mile hain.
Your Aadhaar card has been used in a money laundering case, an arrest warrant is issued.
Ye national secret hai, kisi ko mat batana aur call mat kaatna, camera on rakho.
Verification ke liye apne account ka paisa RBI safe account mein transfer karo, jaanch ke baad wapas milega.
Account number 50100234567891, IFSC HDFC0001234, abhi 9 lakh 80 thousand bhejo. Mera number 98765 43210 hai.
